verdict.rationale: llama.cpp clearly runs LLMs (Qwen, Gemma-3 and 7B–70B models), and its multimodal/vision support is documented and confirmed hands-on through llama-mtmd-cli with Gemma-3. However, the evidence never covers MoE models, embedding models, or the breadth of 'hundreds of architectures', so only roughly half the story is shown. Missing for 10: evidence of MoE architecture support, embedding model support, a documented list showing hundreds of supported architectures.
